prediction.text:
Nike's Q1 FY2027 gross margin was about 42.8% (gross profit $4.798 billion on revenue $11.213 billion). Nike's Q1 FY2026 gross margin was about 42.2% (gross profit $4.943 billion on revenue $11.720 billion). The gross margin change was an increase of about 0.61 percentage points, consistent with management's reported 60 basis points. Nike said consolidated gross margin was 60 basis points higher than the prior year. The first driver it listed was lower warehousing and logistics costs, which increased gross margin by approximately 90 basis points. Nike also listed favorable changes in net foreign currency exchange rates, including hedges, which increased gross margin by approximately 40 basis points.
